args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (channel timestamps, UTC-5). Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

In that post you said the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel doesn't say what the guard did apart from that, until Mateo posted at 11:03 AM that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. You posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07. So the clipboard was in use from at least 10:42 until kiosk 1 came back around 11:03, and I can't see when the guard stopped using it for lane 2.

I replied in the thread in #inc-vtg-hartford. You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. I took that from the channel timestamps, which I assumed are UTC-5 like your message.

Your post said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel doesn't say anything else about what the guard did until 11:03 AM. Mateo posted then that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. You posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

So the clipboard was in use from 10:42 until kiosk 1 came back around 11:03. The channel doesn't show when the guard stopped using it for lane 2.
And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?

Ruth, it's INC-4821. Gideon posted at 11:08 AM on 3 Aug that he'd attached the status-page screenshot to that ticket. That was for the status-page access problem, which Mateo's login hit ("access denied").

The status-page screenshot is on ticket INC-4821. I posted that as a reply to you in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Gideon's 11:08 AM post on 3 Aug says he attached the screenshot to that ticket. It was for the status-page access problem, where Mateo's login got "access denied".
